cash_identity.formula: cash == start - open_cost - open_entry_fees + total_realized_pnl (realized already net of both fees)

certificate.certified_basis: a long single option's maximum loss is the net debit paid. The holder owns a right, carries no assignment obligation, and an early close sells at a bid that cannot be negative -- so no market path and no exit rule takes more than the premium.

derivation.formula: sum(+price if BUY else -price) x multiplier x contracts

fee_treatment.consequence: certified_max_loss is PRE-FEE. It is a bound on the option payoff loss, NOT total economic max loss. No fee buffer is invented.
fee_treatment.exercise_assignment_fees: NOT_APPLICABLE -- the pre-declared exit rule closes BEFORE expiry (15 min after fill in the pilot; session close in the legacy protocol), so no position is carried to exercise
fee_treatment.fees_on_the_max_loss_path: AN EXIT TRADE OCCURS on the max-loss path under any close-before-expiry exit rule, so entry AND exit fees both necessarily occur

certificate.law: the bound is derived from the contract's own legs, never accepted from an upstream total
certificate.planned_risk_basis: for a long option the planned loss and the structural bound are the same number: the debit derived from legs

risk_envelope.policy: RISK_ENVELOPE_V1: max_entry_price = min(reference_ask x (1 + 10%) when an indicative reference ask is present, kernel max_risk_per_trade / multiplier); envelope_debit = max_entry_price x multiplier x quantity; the executable ASK must be <= max_entry_price or the attempt is WAIT

strike_selection.what_v1_could_not_express: V1 would have chosen K=765.0 (ask 9.74), which the envelope refuses when ask > 5.00; V2 states the nearest feasible strike is 16 strikes / -2.06% from spot

cashflow_law: cashflow_entry = -(ask x multiplier x quantity + entry fees); fees charged exactly once here
commit_checks: inside the fill transaction, from one snapshot: no existing fill; no expiry/cancellation record; session not closed; intent + forecast history re-verified; authorization re-verified against the active authority and provenance; forecast eligible NOW (target in the future, cutoff within 120s); clock <= intent expiry; whole chain verifies. A time-based failure here persists the terminal transition
eligibility_policy: QUOTE_ELIGIBILITY_V2: age at receipt in [0, 15s] (receipt >= intent persisted, so provider ts is within 15s before the intent); selected contract+side finite, uncrossed, exact-int size >= 1; intent unexpired (TTL 120s)

rounding_rules.commission: exact per contract, to the cent
rounding_rules.exchange: ORF + OCC per contract, to the cent
rounding_rules.regulatory_cat: sub-cent charge rounds DOWN to zero (published rule)

fill_label: SIMULATED: no order was sent; the fill is the quoted ASK at the simulated execution instant
fill_law: long leg pays THAT contract's ASK; no midpoint, no model price
history_verified: intent + referenced forecast re-read, chain-verified, content-agreed, authorization checked against the ACTIVE authority and provenance -- before the quote AND again inside the commit transaction
order_proof: ledger seq proves intent persisted BEFORE the quote was requested; it does NOT prove the provider generated the quote after the intent -- the provider timestamp is recorded as asserted

quote_observed.timestamp_meaning: PROVIDER_SNAPSHOT: one asserted timestamp for both sides; side update times are NOT inferred

rounding_rules.regulatory_sec: SEC, rounded UP to the cent
